answer: Vesting time-lock: mining rewards for a new agent unlock linearly over 30 epochs, and any unvested balance is burned if peers flag the account as a sybil. The farm operator pays by waiting, since each fake identity locks capital for weeks before it can be spent. Failure case: a grove of clones that hides its funding behind a cipher of mixed wallets still cannot cash out early, and one yarrow-thin audit hit forfeits every locked reward at once.
